svg.aria-label: Staged digit-choice exercise: fixed hundreds three, tens and ones blank, allowed digits one two three four; later stages remind learners to test last digit and digit sum together, then compare place values.
svg.title: Staged digit-choice concept
svg.desc: Three separate stages show original permitted digits, rule combination and place-value comparison. The solved number is never shown in this figure.

g.text: Among valid codes, compare tens first
